name: foldvari.ch
description: Source of foldvari.ch, my multilingual portfolio: React 19, Vite, build-time prerendering, JSON-LD SEO, strict CSP, Vitest and Vercel serverless APIs.

paragraphs: Source of the trilingual portfolio and business site of Alex Földvári, Frontend / Full-Stack Developer in the Zürich area, live at foldvari.ch. It is a React app that is prerendered to static HTML at build time, served by Vercel, and backed by a few serverless functions for the contact form and a private admin dashboard.
features: React 19, Vite 8, React Router 7. framer-motion in strict LazyMotion mode, CSS Modules on top of a token-based design system, light and dark themes, and lazy-loaded routes that recover from stale chunks after a deploy.

Prerendered, then hydrated. After the client build, Vite builds src/entry-server.jsx for the server. scripts/build-shells.js renders every public route with react-dom/static, merges the route's head tags into the HTML…

Checks that fail the build. A page without an h1, without exactly one and one canonical link, with an inline executable script or a leftover HTML comment, an en or em dash or a sharp s in the generated pages, a sitemap…

Three languages with localized URLs. German at /, English at /en, Hungarian at /hu, plus localized slugs for the CV (/cv, /lebenslauf, /oneletrajz) and the legal pages. Each language group carries hreflang alternates,…

One JSON-LD entity graph. src/seo/entity.js builds a single @graph whose nodes reference each other by @id: Person, ProfessionalService, WebSite, WebPage or ProfilePage, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, Service and OfferCatalog.

requirements.text: The lock state lives in the Vercel Runtime Cache, which has no atomic increment: updates are serialized within a function instance but can still race across instances, and if the cache times out, a login without a valid TOTP code fails closed with a 503.

Vitest covers the shared lead validation, the TOTP code (against the RFC 4226 and RFC 6238 test vectors), scrypt hashes and session tokens, rate limiting, IPv6 grouping and the origin checks, the admin login with its lockouts and TOTP bypass, the screening, deduplication and budgets of the contact and tracking endpoints, key and placeholder parity of the de, en and hu copy,…
